headline: Blue Origin's next New Glenn launch delayed into 2027
summary: Blue Origin's next New Glenn rocket launch has slipped to January 2027, according to a staff memo from CEO Dave Limp, after a May launchpad explosion damaged the launch site and slowed repairs.

claims.statement: Blue Origin's next New Glenn rocket launch has been delayed into 2027.

sources.quote: Blue Origin’s next launch now won’t happen until 2027
Blue Origin's New Glenn launch delay will continue into 2027

claims.statement: The new target launch date is January 2027, per a staff memo from CEO Dave Limp.

sources.quote: Blue Origin plans to do its next New Glenn rocket launch in January 2027, according to CNBC and the Financial Times, which cite a memo from CEO Dave Limp sent to staff.

claims.statement: The delay follows a May launchpad explosion that damaged the New Glenn launchpad.

sources.quote: The new timeline follows a May launchpad explosion that damaged Blue Origin's New Glenn launchpad
Repairs have been slow after an explosion earlier this year.
